A 6-year-old child dies of fear inside the classroom due to his teacher abusing him for not doing his homework! The tragic incident took place in India, and surveillance cameras showed that the teacher grabbed him and began removing part of his clothes in front of his classmates while severely scolding and slapping him on the face, while the little boy was trembling with fear and panic to the point that his heart stopped and he died.
